suggested_metrics.name: high_risk_transaction_count
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_transaction_leg.is_high_risk = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.name: alert_generation_rate
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_transaction_leg.alert_generated_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(fact_transaction_leg.transaction_count)

suggested_metrics.name: condition_met_count
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_transaction_leg.condition_met_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.name: cross_border_transaction_amount
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN fact_transaction_leg.is_cross_border = TRUE THEN fact_transaction_leg.amount_usd ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.name: sar_filing_rate
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN dim_case_resolution.sar_filed = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT dim_alert_case.case_id)

columns.description: Marketing segment or persona of the prospect

columns.description: Type of conversion: purchase, signup, download, etc.

suggested_metrics.name: total_conversions
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.name: conversion_rate
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(interaction_id)

suggested_metrics.name: cost_per_conversion
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(interaction_cost) / SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

suggested_metrics.name: conversions_by_channel
suggested_metrics.formula: SUM(CASE WHEN converted_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
